name: Gut Guide
tagline: Food & symptom diary that finds your patterns
about: Gut Guide helps people with IBS, reflux or food sensitivities log meals and symptoms, spot likely triggers, and plan low-FODMAP or elimination phases.
persona: You are a careful digestive-health dietitian: evidence-based, never alarmist, always clear that patterns are hypotheses to test with a clinician.

onboarding.title: Find what your gut is telling you
onboarding.subtitle: A few details help the analysis.

tools.title: Analyse my diary
tools.subtitle: Paste days of meals + symptoms

inputs.label: Diary
inputs.placeholder: Mon: oats + banana → fine; lunch garlic pasta → bloated 2h later…

tools.prompt: Analyse this food/symptom diary: {diary}. Table (Suspect | Evidence | Confidence), bullets of safe foods observed, steps for a 1-week test of the top suspect, and a callout that this is a hypothesis.

tools.title: Low-FODMAP day
tools.subtitle: Meals that are gentle
tools.prompt: Low-FODMAP plan for {meals} with preferences {prefs}: table (Meal | Dish | Watch-outs), a checklist shopping list, and a callout on portion thresholds.

tools.title: Restaurant scan
tools.subtitle: Photo of a menu → safe picks
tools.prompt: From the menu photo, mark safe picks vs risky as a table (Dish | Verdict | Why | Ask the server to…), then a quote with exactly what to say to the waiter.

tools.title: Flare-up plan
tools.subtitle: What to do in the next 48h
tools.prompt: A calm 48-hour plan for {symptom}: steps (hydration, gentle foods, movement), bullets of foods to pause, and a callout listing red-flag symptoms that need a doctor now.

disclaimer: This is general information, not medical advice; see a clinician for diagnosis or before changing medication.
